description.value: Chicken World is a Canadian fast food chain built around marinated fried and Peri Peri chicken, with BC locations in Surrey, Vancouver, and Victoria. The 96 Avenue Surrey location offers dine-in, drive-thru, and online ordering for delivery or pickup. The menu extends beyond chicken to include burgers, wraps, poutine, and a range of sides.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM record matches Surrey Location 1 at #1-12842 96 Ave, and provides the phone number (604-588-0221) absent from OSM. The About Us page explicitly states dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery options, and the burgers menu lists a Veggie Burger as a vegetarian option. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; 604-588-0221 sourced from website for Surrey Location 1 only.
Website adds unit designator '#1' not present in OSM address: website shows '#1-12842 96 Ave.' vs OSM '12842 96 Avenue'.
Contact page lists postal code V6G 2N1 for Surrey Location 1, but V6G is a Vancouver West End prefix — likely a website data-entry error; postal code omitted from address field.
Website copyright reads '© 2027 Chicken World', a future year — possible template or maintenance artifact, not an indicator the business is closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Chicken World is an actively operating food stop that could serve cycling tourists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Burgers menu lists a Veggie Burger
